snippet.title: I was rebuilt - Trailer
snippet.description:
The trailer for "I was rebuilt", a precision platformer rage game made by Eternal CODE Studio.

🎮 ABOUT THE GAME
I was rebuilt is a challenging precision platformer where frustration and glory are measured in milliseconds.

Take control of R3B, a robot created by Dr. Zhang, and enter "Robot Annihilation Madness" — the most brutal TV show on the planet.

Your goal? Survive 80 meticulously designed levels filled with flamethrowers, saws, homing missiles, bottomless pits, and plenty of other ways to turn yourself into scrap metal.

But beating the game is only the beginning. Push your skills to the limit with Time Attack, Hardcore, and Mirror Mode, and compete for the best times on the global leaderboards.

Do you have what it takes to survive Robot Annihilation Madness?

🔗 DOWNLOAD I WAS REBUILT
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/560080
